integrity: The complete proof and executable finite checks are included. Computation supplements rather than replaces the analytic proof; literature priority and independent validation are not certified.
scientific_limitations: Surjective one-dimensional group cellular automata over a power of a single nonabelian finite simple group; periodic spatial rings. The full-shift conjugacy needs nonzero spatial drift in every permutation component. No conclusion for nonsurjective maps or general boundaries.
title: Exact finite-ring holonomy census for nonabelian group cellular automata
